comment: What the package suite expects of every package set. tests/packages/README.md explains each key.

symbol_floors.comment: A versioned symbol of these libraries needs a version floor on the package that provides the library. rpm and apk name the library itself.

desktop_validate_allow.reason: A session entry is read by display managers, which define DesktopNames for sessions (GDM, SDDM). desktop-file-validate checks application entries and does not know the key.

abi_not_linked.dbus: gnoblin starts dbus-update-activation-environment and the session bus tools; libdbus in the same Arch package is not linked
abi_not_linked.dconf: the GSettings backend that GIO loads as a module at run time; libdconf in the same Arch package is not linked
abi_not_linked.python: runs gdctl and gnoblin-seed-config, which are Python scripts; libpython in the same Arch package is not linked
